thread:
zane: Heads up, we have a customer ticket: repeated small charges on reconnects. looks like truncated tokens are being double-counted when toolcall triggers across routes.
tori: can you drop the request/session id?
zane: session=gh7-9, request=gh7-9-2026, model=redwood-medium, route=eu-west primary -> then fallback. log snip: 
```
14:12:02 REQ id=gh7-9 session=gh7-9 route=eu-west prefix=18
14:12:04 TOOLCALL start session=gh7-9 tool=search
14:12:05 STREAM_TRUNC session=gh7-9 truncated=2 provisional=true
14:12:05 TOOLCALL end session=gh7-9 tokens_tool=12
14:12:06 ROUTE_SWAP session=gh7-9 to=eu-lowcost
14:12:07 STREAM_RESUME session=gh7-9 resumed=20 confirmed=true
BILL provisional: 18+2 route=eu-west
BILL confirmed: 20+12 route=eu-lowcost
```
zane: UI shows 18 + (20+12) = 50 but customer expected net ~38 because the 2 trunc tokens should have been absorbed in the resumed 20.
lee: looks like when toolcall occurs between truncate and resume we emit confirmed toolcall tokens separately and reconciliation fails because ledger keys include route and toolcall tag.
tori: are toolcall tokens batched into the same billing object as resumed stream normally? sometimes we separate tool and stream charges.
lee: we do for visibility. ledger key = {session, route, charge_type}. provisional was charge_type=stream-provisional. confirmed path emitted two charges: stream-confirmed and toolcall-confirmed with different charge_type values. dedupe logic only handles identical charge_type or matching session+seq.
maya: proposed fix: introduce global provisional_nonce per session that is included on any provisional emission (stream or toolcall). then on confirmed events we match and reduce duplicates.
zane: that will cover route swaps and toolcall interleaving. any perf concerns?
quentin: storing provisional_nonce in ledger index increases write fanout slightly but should be fine. bigger question is how console and analytics attribute tokens to route/tool. customers want both: a net-billed amount and a breakdown by feature (tool vs stream).
tori: maybe keep per-event attributes: when confirmed matches provisional_nonce, mark "reconciled_from_nonce": <nonce> and compute net tokens = confirmed_total - sum(provisional matched). then present both net and breakdown.
lee: also need an immutable audit trail so refunds/backfills can be traced to the nonce.
devops-bot: Alert: unmatched_provisional_count increased by 42 in last 15m for high-spend customers.
maya: rollout plan: (A) add provisional_nonce field on truncate and any provisional emission (tiny change) (B) update confirmer to lookup by nonce and collapse duplicate attributions (medium) (C) expose reconciled_nonce mapping in billing exports + add a derived net_tokens in console (small) (D) run backfill job to reconcile last 48h of unmatched provisionals (medium).
quentin: tests: e2e that simulates: truncate -> toolcall -> route swap -> resume with nonce carried. also case: multiple provisional emissions before confirmed (rare).
ori: (from support) pls include a reconciliation script for ops to run per-customer.
maya: will add script. for immediate customer impact we can run backfill for their session range and issue credit if mismatch.
zane: can someone take the quick PR to add nonce on truncate? low risk.
tori: I can do that this afternoon. assigning to @tori.
lee: I'll own the confirmer changes and ledger index migration. will schedule pair with tori for schema.
quentin: analytics: I'll add net_tokens column and a flag showing whether events were reconciled across routes; also keep route-level totals unchanged but add an "adjustment" row to show reconciliations so totals still add up in audit exports.
maya: add alert to routing team: if route swap rate during active streams > 1% we may see more of these. maybe routing policy needs smoothing.
zane: noted. thanks all. please link PRs here and ping when backfill runs so support can close ticket.
